facts.claim: Scanned cover identifies 八宅明鏡 and 埽葉山房刊, despite broader catalogue title乾隆法竅.
Preface dated乾隆55庚戌; not assumed date of this later printing.
凡例 gives upper甲子 male坎1/female艮8(after寄), middle甲子 male巽4/female坤2, lower甲子 male兌7/female艮8. This contradicts unverified online summaries saying middlemale2/female7; scan takes priority.
Contents names上/中/下元男命入中寄坤 and corresponding female入中寄艮.
Upper/middle/lower male甲子 starts坎/巽/兌, female starts中/坤/艮; male reverse order and遇中寄坤, female forward order and遇中寄艮.

facts.section: 排山掌上起三元甲子訣
facts.claim: Mnemonic gives male上1中4下7, female上5中2下8; 男逆女順. This is命卦, not a building flying-star chart.
Repeats male5→2/female5→8; nine甲子/乙丑/丙寅 examples across allthree元. Read and transcribed separately below.
